title: Change-Control and Renewal Record
purpose: Assess material changes and periodic renewal across system, data, workflow, vendor, price, law, evidence, alternatives, and exit.
notes: Synthetic example. Replace all values with authorized local evidence before institutional use.

records.Guidance: Model, software, data, threshold, interface, intended use, population, workflow, provider, subprocessor, hosting, price, law, evidence, or alternative.
records.Institutional response: Annual renewal and vendor proposal to update model, hosting environment, and pricing.

records.Guidance: Identify evidence, validation, economics, quality, accreditation, governance, contract, training, communication, and monitoring records requiring revision.
records.Institutional response: Intended use, validation, economics, security, contract, training, monitoring, and rollback.

records.Guidance: Classify minor, moderate, or major; record restriction, silent mode, rollback, or pause where required.
records.Institutional response: Major change; retain current version while update is evaluated in silent mode.

records.Guidance: Define tests, subgroups, human factors, pilot, training, acceptance thresholds, approval, and release plan.
records.Institutional response: Repeat technical, subgroup, human-factors, workflow, security, and budget tests.

records.Guidance: Reassess lifecycle cost, benefit realization, budget impact, risks, alternatives, and opportunity cost.
records.Institutional response: Current version remains acceptable; staffing redesign and a competing product remain alternatives.

records.Guidance: Continue, continue with conditions, update, restrict, pause, restart, replace, or retire.
records.Institutional response: Conditional renewal of current version for 12 months; update not approved pending local evidence.

records.Guidance: Record fallback, data export, retention and deletion, workflow restoration, staff and patient communication, contract termination, and physical disposition.
records.Institutional response: Maintain export, deletion, fallback, transition, and contract-termination plan.

records.Guidance: Record accountable decision-maker, dissent, conditions, date, evidence cut-off, and next trigger.
records.Institutional response: CMIO and Finance Director; review in six months or at any material change.
